reassessment.details: convert-drawing and create-drawing both PASS. Aspose.Drawing uses System.Drawing namespace. No outstanding blockers.
convert-one-to-pdf now PASS (Wave 5). convert-one-to-word and convert-one-to-image share the same Document pattern — trivially unblockable in Wave 6 using SaveFormat.Docx/Png.
read-gis-data now PASS (Wave 5). convert-gis-data requires format conversion between vector formats (GeoJSON to Shapefile etc.) — Aspose.GIS API supports VectorLayer.Convert(). Feasible in Wave 6.
convert-xbrl now PASS (Wave 5). parse-xbrl requires further API research for parsing/extraction use case.

reassessment.blocker: OMR template generation requires a custom template file (.omr format) which cannot be generated programmatically without Aspose.OMR template editor.
reassessment.recommendation: DEFER to Wave 7+ — requires real .omr fixture file

reassessment.details: render-text-with-font (CODE_HARVESTED) could use programmatic font loading. convert-font blocked on format input file.

reassessment.blocker: Aspose.3D API has complex scene setup. convert-3d-model requires reading a 3D file (OBJ/FBX) — OBJ fixture is now available via generate_obj_fixture(). Feasible in Wave 6.
reassessment.unblock_strategy: Use generate_obj_fixture() to write a minimal OBJ cube; Aspose.3D Scene.Open() then Scene.Save() as FBX

reassessment.details: psd-image-converter, animation-maker, photo-processor all READY_FOR_TRANSFORMATION. Requires .psd fixture but Aspose.PSD has programmatic PsdImage creation. Wave 6 candidate.
reassessment.unblock_strategy: new PsdImage(200, 150) -> AddLayers -> Save as PSD -> reload and convert

reassessment.blocker: CAD files (DWG/DXF) cannot be programmatically generated from first principles without a CAD API fixture generator.
reassessment.recommendation: DEFER — requires real DWG fixture or Aspose.CAD programmatic creation research
